title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 501–550 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Bring a reusable water bottle to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 攜帶可重複使用的水瓶以減少塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: She opened a fresh bottle of milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她開了一瓶新鮮牛奶當早餐。

examples.en: Remember to recycle glass bottles properly.
examples.zh: 記得妥善回收玻璃瓶。

examples.en: Would you like a hot cup of black tea?
examples.zh: 你想來一杯熱紅茶嗎？

examples.en: He won first prize and proudly held the championship cup.
examples.zh: 他贏得第一名，自豪地舉起冠軍獎盃。

examples.en: Place a cup of water beside the bed before sleeping.
examples.zh: 睡前在床邊放一杯水。

examples.en: He drank a glass of fresh orange juice.
examples.zh: 他喝了一杯新鮮柳橙汁。

examples.en: Be careful because broken glass can easily cut your hand.
examples.zh: 小心點，碎玻璃很容易割傷你的手。

examples.en: He wears reading glasses when working on the computer.
examples.zh: 他用電腦工作時會戴老花眼鏡。

examples.en: Put the sliced fruit on a clean white plate.
examples.zh: 把切好的水果放在乾淨的白盤子上。

examples.en: She dropped the ceramic plate and it shattered onto the floor.
examples.zh: 她摔落了陶瓷盤子，盤子在地上碎裂開來。

examples.en: He finished everything on his plate without wasting food.
examples.zh: 他吃光了盤裡的所有食物，沒有浪費半點糧食。

examples.en: I had a hot bowl of wonton soup for lunch.
examples.zh: 我中午吃了一碗熱騰騰的餛飩湯。

examples.en: Mix the eggs and sugar in a large ceramic bowl.
examples.zh: 在大瓷碗裡將雞蛋和糖攪拌均勻。

examples.en: She poured fresh milk into the cat's feeding bowl.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮牛奶倒進貓咪的食盆裡。

examples.en: Use a fork and knife to eat your steak.
examples.zh: 用叉子和刀子吃你的牛排。

examples.en: She picked up a piece of melon with a small fruit fork.
examples.zh: 她用小水果叉叉起了一塊甜瓜。

examples.en: Set the table with forks on the left side of the plates.
examples.zh: 擺好餐具，把叉子放在餐盤的左側。

examples.en: Add a spoonful of honey to your tea.
examples.zh: 在茶裡加一湯匙蜂蜜。

examples.en: Feed the baby soup with a soft plastic spoon.
examples.zh: 用柔軟的塑膠湯匙餵寶寶喝湯。

examples.en: Stir the hot coffee thoroughly with a small spoon.
examples.zh: 用小湯匙把熱咖啡徹底攪拌均勻。

examples.en: Be careful! That kitchen knife is very sharp.
examples.zh: 小心！那把菜刀非常鋒利。

examples.en: Use a butter knife to spread peanut butter on toast.
examples.zh: 用奶油刀將花生醬抹在吐司上。

examples.en: Keep sharp knives out of reach of young children.
examples.zh: 把鋒利的刀具收在幼童碰不到的地方。

examples.en: Taiwanese people use chopsticks to eat noodles.
examples.zh: 台灣人用筷子吃麵。

examples.en: Can you hold chopsticks properly when eating rice?
examples.zh: 你吃米飯時能拿好筷子嗎？

examples.en: Using reusable chopsticks helps protect the environment.
examples.zh: 使用環保筷有助於保護環境。

examples.en: Could you pass me a box of facial tissue?
examples.zh: 可以遞給我一盒面紙嗎？

examples.en: He wiped his hands with a soft tissue after eating.
examples.zh: 吃完東西後他用柔軟的面紙擦了擦手。

examples.en: Always carry a pack of pocket tissues when going out.
examples.zh: 出門時隨身攜帶一包袖珍面紙。

examples.en: Wash your hands with antibacterial soap.
examples.zh: 用抗菌肥皂洗手。

examples.en: Natural handmade soap is gentle on sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 天然手工皂對敏感肌膚很溫和。

examples.en: Place the wet soap in a well-drained soap dish.
examples.zh: 將濕肥皂放在排水良好的皂盤上。

examples.en: Dry your hands with a clean towel.
examples.zh: 用乾淨的毛巾把手擦乾。

examples.en: Hang the wet bath towel outside in the sun to dry.
examples.zh: 把濕浴巾掛在外面曬太陽晾乾。

examples.en: Bring an extra beach towel when you visit the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 去游泳池時多帶一條海灘毛巾。

examples.en: Dentists recommend changing your toothbrush every three months.
examples.zh: 牙醫建議每三個月更換一次牙刷。

examples.en: An electric toothbrush removes dental plaque more effectively.
examples.zh: 電動牙刷能更有效地清除牙菌斑。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush before going on vacation.
examples.zh: 去度假前別忘了把牙刷打包進去。

examples.en: Squeeze a pea-sized amount of toothpaste onto the brush.
examples.zh: 擠碗豆大小的牙膏在牙刷上。

examples.en: This fluoride toothpaste helps prevent cavities.
examples.zh: 這款含氟牙膏有助於預防蛀牙。

examples.en: Buy a fresh tube of mint toothpaste from the supermarket.
examples.zh: 去超市買一條新的薄荷牙膏。

examples.en: This botanical shampoo smells like mint.
examples.zh: 這款草本洗髮精聞起來有薄荷香氣。

examples.en: Wash your hair with anti-dandruff shampoo twice a week.
examples.zh: 每週用去屑洗髮精洗頭兩次。

examples.en: She prefers using silicone-free shampoo for healthier hair.
examples.zh: 她偏好使用無矽靈洗髮精以保持頭髮健康。

examples.en: Taiwan is a stunning island known for scenic landscapes.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座以壯麗景觀著稱的迷人島嶼。

examples.en: Green Island and Orchid Island are famous diving destinations.
examples.zh: 綠島和蘭嶼是著名的潛水勝地。

examples.en: The small tropical island has pristine white sand beaches.
examples.zh: 這座熱帶小島擁有原始純淨的白沙灘。

examples.en: We built sandcastles on the sandy beach in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們在墾丁的沙灘上堆沙堡。

examples.en: Walking along the beach at sunset feels very relaxing.
examples.zh: 在日落時分沿著海灘漫步感覺非常放鬆。

examples.en: Volunteers gathered on Saturday for a beach cleanup event.
examples.zh: 志工們週六齊聚一堂參加淨灘活動。

examples.en: We took a scenic ferry ride across the sea.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘風景優美的渡輪橫越大海。

examples.en: The blue sea sparkled brilliantly under the bright sunlight.
examples.zh: 蔚藍的海洋在燦爛陽光下閃閃發光。

examples.en: Many fishermen depend on the sea for their livelihood.
examples.zh: 許多漁民依靠大海維持生計。

examples.en: Alishan is famous for its ancient cypress forest.
examples.zh: 阿里山以其古老的紅檜森林聞名。

examples.en: Walking through the quiet forest fills your lungs with fresh air.
examples.zh: 漫步在寧靜的森林裡讓你的肺部吸飽新鮮空氣。

examples.en: The Amazon rainforest is vital for global oxygen production.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜雨林對全球氧氣生成至關重要。

examples.en: Elephant Mountain is an easy hill to climb for night views.
examples.zh: 象山是一座很容易攀登觀賞夜景的小山。

examples.en: Rolling green hills surrounded the peaceful countryside village.
examples.zh: 綿延起伏的綠色丘陵環繞著這座寧靜的鄉村聚落。

examples.en: We rode our bicycles up the steep hill with great effort.
examples.zh: 我們費力地騎著腳踏車衝上陡峭的小山坡。

examples.en: The mountain air is crisp, cool, and fresh.
examples.zh: 山上的空氣清新、涼爽又新鮮。

examples.en: Open the windows every morning to let fresh air circulate.
examples.zh: 每天早晨打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣流通。

examples.en: Air pollution in urban cities is becoming a serious health concern.
examples.zh: 都會區的空氣污染正成為嚴重的健康隱憂。

examples.en: We all need to protect our Mother Earth.
examples.zh: 我們大家都需要保護我們的地球母親。

examples.en: Earth travels around the sun once every 365 days.
examples.zh: 地球每 365 天圍繞太陽公轉一次。

examples.en: Gardeners dig rich black earth to plant spring flowers.
examples.zh: 園丁們挖掘肥沃的黑泥土來種植春季花卉。

examples.en: The path in the park is paved with smooth stones.
examples.zh: 公園裡的小徑鋪著平滑的鵝卵石。

examples.en: Children love skipping stones across the calm river surface.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在平靜的河面上打水漂石子。

examples.en: The ancient castle was constructed from sturdy gray stone.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡是由堅固的灰色岩石建成的。

examples.en: Many people enjoy keeping green indoor plants.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在室內擺放綠色植栽。

examples.en: Water your potted plants once every two days.
examples.zh: 每兩天為你的盆栽植物澆一次水。

examples.en: The local government plans to plant more trees along the street.
examples.zh: 地方政府計劃在街道兩旁種植更多樹木。

examples.en: The Taipei Zoo cares for thousands of animals.
examples.zh: 台北市立動物園照料著數千隻動物。

examples.en: It is our duty to protect rare and endangered wild animals.
examples.zh: 保護稀有與瀕危野生動物是我們的責任。

examples.en: Dogs and cats are among the most popular domestic animals.
examples.zh: 狗和貓是最受歡迎的家養寵物動物之一。

examples.en: Keeping a pet requires love, time, and responsibility.
examples.zh: 飼養寵物需要愛心、時間和責任感。

examples.en: The kind girl gently pet the sleeping golden retriever.
examples.zh: 善良的女孩溫柔地撫摸著熟睡的黃金獵犬。

examples.en: Do you have any pets at home, like a dog or bird?
examples.zh: 你家裡有養任何寵物嗎，像是狗或鳥？

examples.en: Look at that cute little stray kitten!
examples.zh: 快看那隻可愛的小流浪貓！

examples.en: She bought a pair of cute cartoon socks yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天買了一雙可愛的卡通襪子。

examples.en: The baby made a cute face whenever hearing sweet music.
examples.zh: 寶寶每當聽到悅耳音樂時都會擺出可愛表情。

examples.en: Thank you for hosting such a lovely dinner.
examples.zh: 感謝你舉辦如此美好的晚餐聚會。

examples.en: What a lovely garden filled with blooming red roses!
examples.zh: 多麼美麗別緻、開滿盛開紅玫瑰的花園啊！

examples.en: She has a lovely voice and sings lullabies softly.
examples.zh: 她的嗓音很甜美，輕聲哼唱著搖籃曲。

examples.en: The comedian told a hilarious and funny joke.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員講了一個非常滑稽好笑的笑話。

examples.en: My little brother makes funny facial expressions when he gets angry.
examples.zh: 我弟弟生氣時會做出滑稽好笑的面部表情。

examples.en: There is a funny noise coming from the car engine.
examples.zh: 汽車引擎發出一種古怪異常的聲音。

examples.en: Please be quiet while studying in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館讀書時請保持安靜。

examples.en: We spent a quiet afternoon sipping tea in the yard.
examples.zh: 我們在院子裡喝茶度過了一個寧靜祥和的下午。

examples.en: She is a quiet girl who prefers reading over talking.
examples.zh: 她是個文靜的女孩，比起聊天更喜歡看書。

examples.en: The night market gets very lively and noisy at night.
examples.zh: 夜市在晚上變得非常熱鬧喧囂。

examples.en: It is difficult to concentrate in such a noisy coffee shop.
examples.zh: 在這麼吵鬧的咖啡廳裡很難集中注意力。

examples.en: Our neighbors threw a noisy party late into the night.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居舉辦了一場喧鬧的深夜派對。

examples.en: The backpack is too heavy for the little boy.
examples.zh: 這個書包對小男孩來說太重了。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused localized flooding on the downtown streets.
examples.zh: 豪大雨導致市中心街道出現局部積水。

examples.en: Heavy traffic on Friday afternoon delayed our trip to Taichung.
examples.zh: 週五下午的沉重車潮延誤了我們前往台中的行程。

examples.en: Carry a light jacket in case the weather turns cool.
examples.zh: 帶件薄夾克以防天氣轉涼。

examples.en: She prefers a light breakfast like yogurt and sliced fruit.
examples.zh: 她偏好清淡簡單的早餐，例如優格和切片水果。

examples.en: This aluminum laptop is exceptionally light and portable.
examples.zh: 這款鋁合金筆記型電腦格外輕巧便攜。

examples.en: Keep your desk neat, tidy, and clean.
examples.zh: 保持你的書桌整齊又乾淨。

examples.en: Remember to clean the bathroom thoroughly every weekend.
examples.zh: 記得每個週末把浴室徹底打掃乾淨。

examples.en: Drink plenty of clean water to maintain good health.
examples.zh: 多喝純淨的水以維持身體健康。

examples.en: Wash your dirty hands after playing outside.
examples.zh: 在戶外玩耍後要把髒手洗乾淨。

examples.en: Put your dirty clothes into the laundry basket.
examples.zh: 把你的髒衣服放進洗衣籃裡。

examples.en: Muddy boots will dirty the clean living room floor.
examples.zh: 沾滿泥巴的靴子會把乾淨的客廳地板弄髒。

examples.en: Taiwan is rich in diverse fruits and delicious snacks.
examples.zh: 台灣富含多樣的水果和美味小吃。

examples.en: He became rich through decades of hard work and investments.
examples.zh: 他經過數十年的辛勤工作與投資致富。

examples.en: Dark chocolate has a rich, deep, and satisfying flavor.
examples.zh: 黑巧克力具有濃郁、深沉且令人滿足的風味。

examples.en: The charity raises money to support poor families.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構募款以資助貧困家庭。

examples.en: Poor eye posture can lead to severe nearsightedness in children.
examples.zh: 不良的用眼姿勢可能導致兒童高度近視。

examples.en: The poor stray puppy shivered in the cold winter rain.
examples.zh: 可憐的流浪小狗在寒冷的冬雨中瑟瑟發抖。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake boasts beautiful mountain views.
examples.zh: 日月潭坐擁美麗的湖光山色。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful traditional dress to the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件美麗的傳統服飾參加文化祭典。

examples.en: Sunsets over the western coast are breathtakingly beautiful.
examples.zh: 西海岸的夕陽景致美得令人屏息。

examples.en: The actor looks very handsome in a suit.
examples.zh: 那位演員穿上西裝看起來非常帥氣。

examples.en: He received a handsome salary bonus at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 他在年底領取了一筆相當豐厚可觀的獎金。

examples.en: My grandfather was remarkably handsome in his youth.
examples.zh: 我的祖父年輕時相貌非常英俊英挺。

examples.en: It is very kind of you to help me with the luggage.
examples.zh: 你幫我搬行李真是太好心了。

examples.en: What kind of music do you like listening to while working?
examples.zh: 你工作時喜歡聽哪種類型的音樂？

examples.en: She has a kind heart and frequently volunteers at the shelter.
examples.zh: 她有一顆善良的心，經常在收容所擔任志工。

examples.en: Saying 'please' and 'thank you' is polite.
examples.zh: 說「請」和「謝謝」是有禮貌的表現。

examples.en: The hotel clerk was exceptionally polite and attentive to guests.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃台人員對待客人格外有禮貌且體貼周到。

examples.en: It is polite to listen patiently before offering your opinion.
examples.zh: 在發表自己的意見之前耐心傾聽是有禮貌的作法。

examples.en: It is rude to interrupt someone when they speak.
examples.zh: 在別人說話時插嘴是不禮貌的。

examples.en: The waiter received complaints because of his rude attitude.
examples.zh: 那位服務生因為粗魯無禮的態度而遭到投訴。

examples.en: It is rude to stare pointedly at strangers on the subway.
examples.zh: 在捷運上盯著陌生人看是非常不禮貌的。

examples.en: Dad is busy preparing for his morning presentation.
examples.zh: 爸爸正忙著準備早上的簡報。

examples.en: Zhongxiao East Road is one of the busiest streets in Taipei.
examples.zh: 忠孝東路是台北最繁忙熱鬧的街道之一。

examples.en: I am too busy this week to join the weekend hiking trip.
examples.zh: 我這週太忙了，無法參加週末的登山行程。

examples.en: Are you free to grab a cup of coffee this afternoon?
examples.zh: 你今天下午有空喝杯咖啡嗎？

examples.en: Children under six years old enjoy free admission to the museum.
examples.zh: 六歲以下兒童可免費參觀這座博物館。

examples.en: Birds flying high in the sky are wild and free.
examples.zh: 在高空中翱翔的鳥兒狂野且自由自在。

examples.en: Taiwan is widely considered a very safe place to travel.
examples.zh: 台灣普遍被認為是一個非常安全的旅遊勝地。

examples.en: Fasten your seatbelt securely to stay safe during the flight.
examples.zh: 在飛行途中繫好安全帶以策安全。

examples.en: Store important documents and cash in a fireproof safe.
examples.zh: 將重要文件和現金存放在防火保險箱中。

examples.en: It is dangerous to cross the road while using your phone.
examples.zh: 邊滑手機邊過馬路是危險的。

examples.en: Driving on mountain roads during heavy rain is extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 豪雨期間在山路上開車是極其危險的。

examples.en: Do not touch exposed electrical wires because they are dangerous.
examples.zh: 請勿觸碰裸露的電線，因為它們非常危險。

examples.en: She is smart and always solves math riddles quickly.
examples.zh: 她很聰明，總是能迅速解開數學謎題。

examples.en: Modern smart homes can control lights and air conditioning automatically.
examples.zh: 現代智慧家庭可以自動調節燈光與空調。

examples.en: Wearing a smart blazer makes a positive impression at an interview.
examples.zh: 面試時穿著一套俐落帥氣的西裝外套能留下良好印象。

examples.en: Don't do silly things that might hurt yourself.
examples.zh: 別做可能會傷害自己的傻事。

examples.en: It was a silly mistake that could have been easily avoided.
examples.zh: 那是一個本來可以輕易避免的糊塗小錯誤。

examples.en: I felt stupid after realizing I had put my shirt on backwards.
examples.zh: 在發現自己把衣服穿反之後，我感到自己好蠢。

examples.en: Regular exercise will help you stay strong and energetic.
examples.zh: 規律運動會幫助你保持強壯且充滿活力。

examples.en: The typhoon brought strong winds that knocked down trees.
examples.zh: 颱風帶來強風，吹倒了路邊的路樹。

examples.en: She ordered a cup of strong black coffee to stay awake.
examples.zh: 她點了一杯濃郁的黑咖啡來提神。

examples.en: I felt weak after recovering from the flu.
examples.zh: 流行性感冒痊癒後我感到身體有些虛弱。

examples.en: The wooden bridge is too weak to support heavy vehicles.
examples.zh: 這座木橋結構太脆弱，無法承載重型車輛。

examples.en: Math has always been my weakest subject in school.
examples.zh: 數學一直是我在學校裡最薄弱的科目。
